slice.result: The pinned DirectorySource implementation is filesystem-backed. update() enumerates the configured local root, requires each package to contain Cargo.toml and .cargo-checksum.json, and loads packages from PathSource. download() returns an already-present Package as MaybePackage::Ready; finish_download() panics with 'no downloads to do'. verify() recomputes SHA256 over every file listed in .cargo-checksum.json and fails on mismatch. No network operation appears in this implementation body.
slice.inference: For an already-complete directory source, this implementation provides a concrete local reuse and integrity-check pattern whose query/download/verify path is satisfied from local files and checksums. This narrows the use-time network question positively for DirectorySource itself, but does not establish source-replacement activation semantics or prove that Cargo will never consult another source under a given configuration.
slice.scope_guard: Evidence is limited to rust-lang/cargo src/sources/directory.rs at pinned commit 7941be6fb416b4cd9666aef7b858dfea25587a8c. It does not prove how the directory source is selected, whether source replacement is complete/fail-closed, how the vendored tree was initially produced, or end-to-end scheduled-Chat parity.

residual_uncertainty: Initial creation and provenance of a complete vendored dependency tree without richer-mode or user execution remain unresolved.
End-to-end useful outcome parity remains unverified.
